_readme: Optional config file for the MCP server. Copy to tools/mcp/config.json (gitignored),
or point THREED_CONFIG at it. Every key here also has a THREED_* environment variable,
which wins over this file — see the README's MCP table. Keys are checked on startup, so
a typo stops the server with a message rather than being ignored. Delete what you do not
need; the values below are the defaults.
No credentials belong in this file: publishing shells out to tools/publish.sh, which
resolves them from the named profile with `aws configure export-credentials`.
_readme_aws: Which profile signs POST /publish. Unset means the default credential chain.
_readme_endpoints: Unset means: read ApiUrl/SiteUrl out of cdk-outputs.json.
_readme_freecad: freecadcmd is not on PATH in a default macOS install.
_readme_defaults: Applied when a tool call omits the argument.
_readme_limits: maxModelBytes mirrors the Lambda's cap; warnModelBytes is only advisory.
_readme_guardrails: allowedPaths: [] lets the server read any path its user can. Set it to confine a harness.
allowPublish: false unregisters publish_model and convert_and_publish entirely.
dryRun: true exports and inspects for real but reports the publish command instead of running it.
